pup.css: .c-pup .whole,.c-pup .m-item,.c-pup .m-float,.c-pup .m-paw{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}.c-pup.s-think .paw-l{opacity:0}.c-pup.s-think .m-paw{animation:ppChin 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-think .m-float{animation:ppFl 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-work .m-item{animation:ppDig 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-wait .whole{transform:translateY(-4px)}.c-pup.s-wait .paw-r{opacity:0}.c-pup.s-wait .m-paw{animation:ppSitPaw 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:30% 80%}.c-pup.s-wait .m-item{animation:ppBell 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-happy .whole{animation:ppJump 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-happy .tongue{opacity:1}.c-pup.s-happy .m-float{animation:ppPop 1.2s ease-out infinite}.c-pup.s-alert .whole{transform:translateY(6px) scale(.95,1.05)}.c-pup.s-alert .head-g{transform:translateY(-6px)}.c-pup.s-alert .tail{opacity:.35;transform:rotate(32deg)}.c-pup.s-alert .m-float{animation:ppPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-sad .whole{transform:translateY(8px) scale(1.04,.94)}.c-pup.s-sad .head-g{transform:translateY(5px)}.c-pup.s-sad .tail{opacity:.3;transform:rotate(40deg) translateY(16px)}.c-pup.s-sad .m-float{animation:ppRain 1.4s linear infinite}.c-pup.s-sleep .whole{transform:rotate(-13deg) translateY(9px)}.c-pup.s-sleep .paw-l,.c-pup.s-sleep .paw-r{opacity:0}.c-pup.s-sleep .m-float{animation:ppZzz 2.6s ease-out infinite}.c-pup.s-busy .tongue{opacity:1;animation:ppPant .6s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-busy .paw-r{opacity:0}.c-pup.s-busy .m-paw{animation:ppFan .9s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:25% 75%}.c-pup.s-busy .m-float{animation:ppRain 1.1s ease-in infinite}.c-pup.s-boop .whole{animation:ppBoop 1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-boop .tongue{opacity:1}.c-pup.s-boop .m-float{animation:ppPop 1s ease-out infinite}@keyframes ppChin{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(5deg)}}@keyframes ppFl{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(-10deg)}}@keyframes ppDig{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(6deg)}}@keyframes ppSitPaw{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-20deg)}}@keyframes ppBell{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-10deg)}50%{transform:rotate(12deg)}}@keyframes ppJump{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}@keyframes ppPop{0%,100%{opacity:.25;transform:scale(.7)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2)}}@keyframes ppPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.18)}}@keyframes ppRain{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-5px)}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(11px)}}@keyframes ppZzz{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,5px) scale(.6)}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(14px,-16px) scale(1.15)}}@keyframes ppFan{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-22deg)}50%{transform:rotate(22deg)}}@keyframes ppBoop{0%,100%{transform:scale(1,1)}30%{transform:scale(1.14,.86) translateY(8px)}65%{transform:scale(.93,1.08) translateY(-11px)}}

notes: Each character expresses all nine moods with distinct, in-character silhouettes, props, and whole-body CSS transforms—such as the wizard's floating rune, levitating scroll, hourglass, and starry quilt, the duck's soap-bubble thoughts, shower cap, and hotel bell, the cat's daydream fish, coffee mug, and curled tail over a blanket, and the pup's chewed bone, collar bell, and rapid panting fan. All mood overlays preserve the shared eye zone down to y = 30 (rising to y = 14 only for sleep blankets) while reusing gradients and lightweight transform/opacity keyframes well under the 7 KB per-character budget.
